objective: Reduce the MTP drafter's full-vocabulary projection without changing the FP8 target verifier or visible greedy output.

treatment.draft_projection: runtime group-128 W4A16 with BF16 scales
treatment.implementation: A shallow draft module copy owns nonpersistent packed INT4 buffers while sharing the already-loaded target FP16 parameter. The target module has no INT4 marker or buffers.

first_endpoint_gate.candidate_determinism: 12/12 complete arrays exact across a repeated candidate server required before promotion
first_endpoint_gate.continuation: Only a gate-passing candidate may run the unrepeated natural-content 2K-32K depth matrix.

promotion_gate.quality: Every candidate complete token array must match the corresponding same-image MTP0 oracle; no semantic-only substitution.
promotion_gate.current_boot: Diagnostic only because the boot journal contains an earlier GPU reset. A pass can retain the candidate but cannot promote it.

abort_conditions: target lm_head receives an INT4 marker or packed buffer
draft-only preparation marker is absent on either TP rank
any cached token, canary failure, complete-array mismatch, nondeterminism, NaN, GPU reset, device loss, or new Xe fault
strict decode below the 99% incumbent floor
